notes: Adds Playnite.Core.Import.LibraryImportService over the existing verified path: LegacyLibraryReaderProcess supplies the neutral JSON envelope and LibraryMigration owns validation, staging, verification and publication. The service reports typed checkpoints, returns a structured Published/Planned result only after migration returns, and classifies failures as InvalidRequest, SourceReadFailed, SourceRejected, DestinationUnavailable or PublicationFailed. Re-run refusal and cancellation follow the migration contract: a repeat refuses from the in-artifact receipt and an interrupted run leaves no live destination. Adds the CLI import command over the service; import-v10 and its p4-002 evidence stay unchanged.
